2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch refactors the handling of huge-PMD folios in the madvise code to separate the PMD lock and filtering logic into a new helper function. The goal is to make the code more modular and easier to maintain, without introducing any functional changes. The patch adds a new function called `madvise_lru_huge_pmd_locked` that takes care of locking and referencing folios when they need to be split, and uses this function in place of the existing logic in the `madvice_lru_pmd_entry` function.
